title: Larger seat badges and map fit
description: Seat badges about 40% larger (28 px glyph, 18 px command tokens on the map) and the map fitted between the toolbar row and the bottom prompt, before and after at four viewport sizes.

shots.heading: Legend before
shots.caption: Seat legend on the base commit: 20 px badge glyph, 11 px label.

shots.heading: Legend after
shots.caption: Seat legend: 28 px badge glyph (+40%), 15 px label, in the same row as the toolbar so it never covers tiles.

shots.heading: Standard view at 1440x900, before
shots.caption: Base commit: toolbar and seat legend float over the top tile row and the prompt pill over the bottom row. (no prompt)

shots.heading: Standard view at 1440x900, after
shots.caption: Toolbar and legend take their own row; the map is fitted between it and a 60 px prompt inset. The capture script asserts the hex rows are clear of both. (no prompt)

notes.title: Before shots
notes.text: Captured on the base commit (upstream-pr-2026-10-07) with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before and committed as PNGs; npm run screenshots -- AB regenerates the after-* shots from the current code.

notes.title: Fit
notes.text: The toolbar and seat legend flow in a row above the map (board-chrome); the map stage keeps 60 px free at the bottom for the prompt pill. Reset and zoom operate inside that stage.
